journey: Selected language and reply audio on Android
reason: After user paused other deployments, integrated the latest v0.2.3 legal/profile/logging release, deployed successfully, and completed connected-phone checks. The user confirmed reply audio is audible.

backend.publicHealth: status ok; db ok; version 0.2.3; chat/speech reject unauthorized callers with 401; public WSS authentication rejects invalid token

liveProvider.result: Each selected language returned native reply text and nonempty MP3; mixed-language history did not override delivery. Synthetic requests, no production test accounts.

results.action: Verify version 1.2.3 build 2008 is installed and launches
results.comment: adb install -r succeeded; version 1.2.3 build 2008 confirmed; app data preserved.

results.action: Start Saarthi and verify generic accessibility automation does not turn audio off
results.comment: Phone reached Listening with the restored backend; generic accessibility automation did not expose unexpected screen-reader/audio-off mode. Input was then paused.

results.action: Pause input and select Tamil in Voice options
results.comment: Selected Spoken language / தமிழ் in Voice options while capture was paused.
Typed the synthetic English greeting Hello and sent it with spoken language still Tamil. Text-only mode was used for the repeat check to prevent automatic microphone reopening.

results.action: Verify a Tamil written reply and started Android media/speech playback for this app
results.comment: Phone displayed Tamil: வணக்கம்! இன்று நான் உங்களுக்கு எப்படி உதவ முடியும்? Enabling Read aloud replayed the reply; Android runtime reported app USAGE_MEDIA / CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH with 24 kHz audio preparation. Playback completed without an error, returning to paused. The human user explicitly confirmed the earlier Tamil test replay was audible.

results.action: End the conversation and reopen it
results.comment: End returned to the idle screen; force-stopped and relaunched the app to check persistent language storage, then started and immediately paused input.

results.action: Verify Tamil remains selected and End stops the conversation
results.comment: Voice options still showed Spoken language / தமிழ் after full process restart. Final Read aloud setting restored on; End used to stop the conversation and leave the microphone off.
